g.text: File Chunking: Sync Only What Changed, Dedupe What's Identical
Same file, before and after a small edit -- plus a second file sharing one chunk
File A (after edit) -- only C3 changed
File B (a different file, shares one chunk with File A)
Only C3 gets re-uploaded and pushed to other devices -- C1, C2, C4 are untouched.
File B's C1' hashes the same as File A's C1, so the storage layer keeps ONE copy, referenced twice.
The metadata service tracks each file's chunk-hash list; the chunk store never knows which files reference a chunk.
